objects.name: asset
objects.description: One piece of installed infrastructure: a run of pipe, a transmission line, a valve, a compressor or pump station, a substation, a sensor.

indexes.name: station_type
indexes.description: Separates compressor stations from pump stations, which is a distinction only this domain draws.

objects.name: connection
objects.description: One directed link in the network: what feeds what, what is a component of what, and what instruments what.

objects.name: metric_definition
objects.description: One quantity this utility has decided is worth measuring — a pressure, a voltage, a flow rate — and the unit it is read in.

objects.name: reading
objects.description: One instrument reading against one asset at one moment. The high-frequency table, and the reason the twin is a twin rather than a register.

objects.name: retention_policy
objects.description: How long readings of one kind are kept before the sweep removes them.
